title: Size and resource limits
summary: The largest sizes and budgets the tool accepts, and the error each one produces.

items.text: At most {{maxDimension}} pixels on a side for any image the tool reads, draws, or writes; a larger size is refused with size-limit before any pixels are allocated. 'canvasnet formats' reports it as maxDimension.
Above 0 and at most {{maxDpi}} (PDF, PPTX, VSDX; a VSDX needs a whole number). The default is 96. A page is its size in points times the dpi divided by 72.
JPEG quality {{qualityMin}} to {{qualityMax}}, default {{qualityDefault}}.
An image {{maxDimension}} by {{maxDimension}} pixels uses about 256 MB per copy, so large pipelines need memory.
Default {{scadMaxTriangles}} triangles; a model that needs more fails with budget-exceeded. A model source longer than the library reads is corrupt-input.
800x800 pixels unless --size, --width, --height, or --scale is given.
At most {{vlMaxSourceLength}} characters (corrupt-input) and JSON nesting depth {{vlMaxJsonDepth}} (vega-lite-error).
At most {{vlMaxDataFiles}} files, {{vlMaxDataBytes}} bytes per file, and {{vlMaxDataRows}} rows in total; beyond that the chart fails with budget-exceeded.
At most {{vlMaxImages}} different pictures (image marks); beyond that the chart fails with budget-exceeded.

At most {{vlMaxPaintedPixels}} device pixels painted in one render (fills, strokes, text, and pictures that cover the image count by the area they cover, so marks with huge sizes or stroke widths, or pictures without a size, are stopped); beyond that the chart fails with budget-exceeded, located at the mark.
A chart that lays out larger than {{maxDimension}} pixels on a side is size-limit.
At most {{mmdMaxTextSize}} characters (Mermaid's maxTextSize); a longer text is corrupt-input.

At most {{mmdMaxNodes}} nodes and {{mmdMaxEdges}} edges (Mermaid's maxEdges); beyond that the diagram fails with budget-exceeded (mermaid-limit-exceeded). The text cannot raise a limit: a directive that tries is ignored with the warning mermaid-config-secure-key.
At most {{mmdMaxImages}} pictures (@{ img } nodes and tags in labels); beyond that the diagram fails with budget-exceeded.
A diagram that lays out larger than {{maxDimension}} pixels on a side is size-limit unless --scale, --width, or --height makes it smaller.
At most 5,000,000 characters, nesting depth 100, and 100,000 rendered elements; beyond that the file is corrupt-input.
Opening a presentation buffers the whole package in memory, up to 256 MiB.
canvasnet flatten draws at most 64 pictures (nested ones included) within the pixel budget of render, and writes a copy of at most 64 MiB; a larger copy is size-limit and nothing is written.
A document page is drawn at 96 dpi.

The fragment of an image href in an SVG file, or of an input path on the command line (the part after #, as in report.pdf#page=2), is at most {{fragmentMaxLength}} characters and {{fragmentMaxParameters}} parameters; beyond that the image is not drawn and image-fragment-invalid is reported (an unsupported-feature error with --strict; for an input path, an error).
